name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Data Collection, Validation & Reporting | Excel, SQL, Power BI, Audit-Ready Documentation
summary: Detail-driven data and operations professional who collects, validates, and documents data before anyone downstream relies on it. Runs data imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel and re-checks every load, has cleaned up a 1,400+ contact CRM, and grades output against written quality standards. Builds reports and dashboards in Excel, Power BI, and GA4, writes working SQL, and keeps clear records of every step so the work holds up to review.

experience.title: Data & Operations (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Collect and import data into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, validating every record after load and resolving discrepancies before the data is used.
Built rubric-based grading criteria for an audit process and personally labeled and scored outputs against those standards.
Prepare datasets and build dashboards and summaries in Excel, Power BI, and GA4, querying data with SQL (BigQuery) to answer specific questions.
Document every engagement's data sources, timelines, and processing steps in Notion and HubSpot, keeping records auditable.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built performance reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and summarized findings for client stakeholders.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to flag anomalies and adoption gaps early, supporting ~94% partner retention.
Set up customers on Birdeye's listings-syndication solution, where accurate, consistent business data across directories was the core of the product.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Defined and labeled the CRM fields required for sales and onboarding workflows in Salesforce, standardizing data capture across a team of up to 30.
Managed about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak while launching 25+ clients per month.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
